description: Checkpoint state for the dance skill. Persisted at <applications-root>/.dance-state.json between phase transitions.

bumpSize.description: Auto-decided or user-supplied bump size for the spernakit template.

completedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when Part D finished. Null until D-complete.

decidedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the latest preflight bump-size decision.

directFixes.description: Direct-remediation log from Part B (>=3-app clusters, keyed by route, error class, and first stack frame).

signature.description: Cluster signature (route + error class + first stack frame).

notes.description: Free-form notes captured during the dance, surfaced in the session report.

D3_tagged.description: Tag string written, e.g., 'v1.4.2'. Null if not tagged.

perApp.description: Per-app outcome map keyed by app slug.

phase.description: Current phase. Used by --resume-from to know where to pick up. Part C sits at 'C-pending' while it implements and while any feature remains unresolved, moves to 'C-complete' only when every enumerated feature resolved, and takes 'C-skipped' when C1 found none.

pilot.description: Derived app slug used as the Part A pilot. Defaults to the first pinned app in spernakit.psd1, resolved at run time; override with --pilot.

remediationFeatures.description: Paths to feature records created by Part B's formal route. Findings use remediation-* in either repository; durable features use clean slugs.

scope.description: List of derived app slugs in scope for this dance.

startedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the dance started.

from.description: Spernakit version before the dance, e.g., '3.2.1'.

to.description: Spernakit version after Part A1. Null until A1 completes.

version.description: Schema version. Bump when making breaking changes to the checkpoint format.

title: DanceCheckpoint
